source: 1/8/32 actual PlayerList-registered ServerPlayer instances; EmbeddedChannel simulated connections; natural player Post ticks dispatch LOOP and HEALTH
percentile_method: nearest rank ceil(p*n)-1; warmup and profile ticks excluded
measurement_mode: AcademyProfiler and sampling profiler disabled for measured ticks; opt-in stage wall/CPU/allocation and program-network counters enabled. This includes measurement overhead and is not production-default instrumentation-off cost.
timing_scope: Per-tick sum of observed Manager dispatch and scheduler key-tick intervals. Nested stages overlap their parent; do not add all stages together. Optional server_tick_event_interval runs Pre HIGHEST to this Post LOWEST, before fixture drain/checks; not complete tickServer or TPS.
allocation_scope: current server thread only; nested clock/recording overhead retained; native/other-thread allocations excluded
network_scope: shared capture helper directly observes and decodes the actual sent S2CPacket body outside timed intervals; payload and Misaka envelope bytes; no observer re-encode and not TCP/framing/compression/bandwidth
limitations: Not 32 Minecraft clients, WAN or client rendering.
Control/query/transaction workloads have no paid category action; they do not measure physics/CP spending/cooldowns.
LOOP precedes HEALTH and shares the per-player budget; this benchmark does not claim cross-trigger fairness.
Books are installed directly through real player data during setup; network save/revision correctness is a separate fixture.
Post-tick live-session counts can miss within-tick peaks; scheduler admission/completion counters separately verify real sessions.
Default max 256 sessions is unchanged; boundary uses real 32-player x9 automatic long-WAIT programs.

production_network_metrics_measured.send_scope: Calls to Misaka send, including synchronous wrapper construction/encoding and connection enqueue; not delivery acknowledgement
production_network_metrics_measured.timing_scope: nanoTime wall elapsed, optional current-thread CPU and heap allocation counters; nested send/encode times must not be summed
production_network_metrics_measured.payload_bytes_scope: Application packet CODEC bytes only; excludes Misaka registry id, Minecraft framing/compression/encryption and TCP/IP
